design_gotchas.title: OBSOLETE / EOL Device — Mandatory Migration Target for Active BOMs
design_gotchas.detail: 300 DPI Vision inspection of PDF pages 2-4 reveals a full-page OBSOLETE watermark ('THIS DEVICE IS OBSOLETE'). Do not design CAT6219-330TD-GT3 into new projects; evaluate active Pin-4-BYPASS SOT-23-5 / TSOT-23-5 candidate replacements such as TPS73633DBVR (400 mA) or LP2985-33DBVR (150 mA) after verifying load and ESR limits.

design_gotchas.title: Continuous 500 mA Operation Overheats TSOT-23-5 (θJA = 235°C/W)
design_gotchas.detail: Table 3 (PDF p.3) explicitly warns that continuous operation at 500 mA in SOT23-5/TSOT-23-5 may exceed maximum junction temperature and trip thermal shutdown (160°C). At 5.0 V to 3.3 V, 500 mA dissipates 0.85 W (> 199°C rise at 235°C/W); practical continuous current at 5 V->3.3 V is under ~200 mA at TA = 25°C.

design_gotchas.title: Internal 2.5 MOhm EN Pull-Down & 5 mOhm Minimum ESR Floor
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike LDOs with internal EN pull-ups, leaving Pin 3 floating disables the CAT6219 via its 2.5 MOhm pull-down (PDF p.4). In addition, Table 4 specifies a 5 mOhm minimum ESR floor; ultra-low-ESR paralleled MLCCs can fall below 5 mOhm, and shutdown activates a 250 ohm output discharge switch.

typical_use_cases: Legacy 500 mA portable electronics and USB-powered rails requiring EOL cross-reference migration
Compact TSOT-23-5 3.3 V low-noise rails with Pin 4 bypass capacitor (10 nF)
Low-quiescent-current (55 uA) battery-powered systems needing active output discharge on disable
Reference baseline when migrating obsolete CAT6219 footprints to active SOT-23-5/TSOT-23-5 candidate drop-ins
engineering_summary: The onsemi CAT6219-330TD-GT3 is an OBSOLETE (EOL) 500 mA CMOS LDO in TSOT-23-5 (CASE 419AE) featuring 55 uA quiescent current, 300 mV typical dropout at 500 mA, 64 dB PSRR, and a Pin 4 BYP capacitor input. Shutdown ground current has no typical value published (1 uA max at 25°C, 2 uA max over TJ). Because the part is EOL and thermally constrained at 235°C/W, engineers maintaining legacy boards should treat compatible active SOT-23-5 BYPASS-pin LDOs as candidate drop-ins and verify current, ESR, and EN pull-down behavior before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision check on PDF p.2-4 detected prominent OBSOLETE watermark across the entire datasheet (lifecycle_status set to EOL).
300 DPI PNG Vision check on PDF p.2-3 confirmed TSOT-23-5 Top View pinout (1=VIN, 2=GND, 3=EN, 4=BYP, 5=VOUT), no exposed pad, and θJA=235°C/W.
300 DPI PNG Vision check on PDF p.4 (Table 4) confirmed IGND-SD Typ cell is blank (Max=1 uA @25°C / 2 uA over TJ), so ishdn_typ_ua is honestly set to null.
